description: This Java class `ImmutableAdaptableBuilder` implements the `AdaptableBuilder` interface to construct instances of `ImmutableAdaptable`. The builder manages setting payloads and headers and provides a static factory method for creation with a specified `TopicPath`.

classes.name: ImmutableAdaptableBuilder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe builder class for creating `ImmutableAdaptable` instances, managing topic path, payload, and headers.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new `ImmutableAdaptableBuilder` with a specified `TopicPath`.

parameters.name: topicPath
parameters.description: The topic path for which to create the builder.

methods.name: withPayload
methods.description: Sets the payload for the builder.

methods.name: withHeaders
methods.description: Sets the headers for the builder.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs an `ImmutableAdaptable` instance with the current state of the builder.
